rationale: Kept PI+adaptive-FF structure but retargeted for ~2.2x outflow: faster measurement filter (TF 10->6s) and steady filter (TS 70->32s), dual-rate k_hat adaptation that still learns during transients (55s steady / 220s transient vs 180s gated-off), widened K bounds to 0.30-1.35, re-tuned integral to be strong when far (KI_FAR 0.008->0.045, ERR_FAR 0.15->0.08, KI 0.02->0.018, I_LIM 0.65->0.75, P_LIM 0.60->0.65, KP 1.0->0.9). This lets u* move 0.39->0.95 quickly after the drop while freezing windup at saturation so nominal overshoot stays <0.6.

extra.machine_card: Heater with ~2.2x heat loss: tau 155s->~75s, K 1.05->0.43 (amb ~0.085), u* for y=0.5 0.39->~0.95, deadtime still <10s, noise/quant ~0.005 unchanged, saturation at u=1 leaves ~0.05 headroom.
extra.predicted_behavior: Nominal (old plant): cold start to 0.5 in ~150-180s, overshoot <0.06 to ~0.54-0.56 decaying in ~200s, MAE ~0.011 and in-band ~0.79 after 300s, u settles ~0.39. Changed plant (high loss): after sudden drop y recovers from ~0.36 toward band within ~200-300s, u drives to 0.95-1.0 then backs to ~0.93-0.97, y re-enters 0.475-0.525 without hitting 0.85/0.9, steady MAE <0.01. Adaptation confirmed by ff rising and integral unwinding, not by oscillation.
extra.diagnosis: Outflow/loss increased ~2.1-2.4x. Zero-input test is decisive: E3 0.421->0.185 in 180s (tau~153s, amb~0.08) vs E7 0.40->0.094 in 300s with >0.12 fall in first 60s (tau~70-85s, amb~0.09). Heating tests confirm: E1 u=0.5 reaches 0.443 in 180s toward ~0.61 while E8 u=0.5 from 0.094 reaches only 0.298 after 240s flat; E9+E10 u=0.8 from 0.298 reaches 0.40 in 110s and 0.432 in 195s toward ~0.44-0.46. Hence steady gain K=(yss-amb)/u 1.04-1.07 old -> 0.42-0.44 new, u* for 0.5 is 0.39-0.40 old -> 0.93-0.97 new. Delay remains <10-15s prompt fall/rise in E7/E8/E9 and sensor quantization ~0.005/low noise unchanged, ruling out response_slower and sensor_changed. Halved tau + halved K with same b is exactly larger a.
